title: Funding source
description: One funding source: its tasks, budget lines, certification text and contract settings (SPEC §3). Format version 1.

id.description: Stable id stored on entries and invoices. Never changes once released.

code.description: Short name shown on the source chip and used in file names, e.g. TISUPP.

name.description: Full name printed on the invoice.

version.description: Release number of this source's content. Bump it when tasks, lines or text change.

has_nte.description: Whether the CHW's agreement has a not-to-exceed amount tracked on invoices.

default_rate_cents.description: Hourly rate prefilled at setup, in cents, or null for none.

certification_text.description: Certification printed above the CHW signature.

tasks.description: Tasks in display and timesheet order.

core_competency.description: Core competency, or null when the task has none.
